title: Handshakes That Don't Cross
summary: Determine the number of non-crossing handshakes among an even number of people standing in a circle, ensuring the result is modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Determine the number of non-crossing handshakes among an even number of people standing in a circle, ensuring the result is modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: An even number of people sit around a circle and each person shakes exactly one hand.
Handshake chords may not cross inside the circle.
Return the number of pairings modulo 1000000007.
hints: Pair one fixed person and consider how many pairs lie on each side of that chord.
The two sides are independent smaller noncrossing matching problems.
Sum their product over every possible split.
Every noncrossing matching has one unique partner for the fixed person, yielding the Catalan recurrence.

tests.explanation: The only two people form one handshake.
The four people have two noncrossing perfect matchings.
